featured_reviews.name: Vicky Mayekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Fast and Foodie US Restaurant with high expectations, but unfortunately, my experience was a letdown. I ordered the Chicken Lolipop Masala and Butter Chicken with Butter Garlic Naan. The service was prompt, but that's where the positives end.
The Chicken Lolipop Masala was served cold, and it seemed like it was pre-made, which was disappointing. The taste was also off, and I couldn't enjoy it. The Butter Chicken was not buttery at all, and it had a strange flavor, almost like it had a lot of MSG (Ajinomoto) in it.
Considering the issues with the food, I wouldn't recommend visiting this restaurant unless they revamp their menu and service quality. Hopefully, they'll take customer feedback seriously and make necessary improvements.

featured_reviews.name: Sheshank Jaiswal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited this place for the first time and I must say the as the name stands you will get the best samosa in Thane the crisp and the filling test it’s wooowww!!Though they have different varieties like Ulta Vada Pav, Crispy Vada Pav, Crispy Bread Pakoda, Chole Samosa & Kadi Samosa (which is available from 9am and is available till its over, so go early in the morning for this)

Talking more on Samosa it has good amount of mixed vegetables like french beans and carrots and taste really different and good than the normal potato based Samosas you will find at other places. The green chutney that comes with it is nice & thick.

I personally request to visit this place once who stays in Thane or nearby Thane. You will surely enjoy the Samosa with Tea. Best time I would suggest to go during evening.

The place also has the sittings upto 16 people. Where to you can sit comfortably and enjoy the food.

featured_reviews.name: Boy On The Saddle Alfred
featured_reviews.review_text:
Things to try: Vegetable Samosa and City Special Samosa

Vegetable samosa has good amount of mixed vegetables like french beans and carrots and taste really different and good than the normal potato based Samosas. The green chutney that comes with it is nice & thick but the tamarind was watery and could have been better.

City Special Samosa comes with Cashewnuts and this was again something different to have.

There are other dishes like Chole Samosa & Kadi Samosa (which is available from 9am and is available till its over, so go early in the morning for this)

Also, I docked one star because the person managing the counter was busy talking with someone and I was keen to know more about the specialties of the store. It would be a good idea to interact with your customers and pay attention to them if you want the word to spread around.
